title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. M = ⊕_{j=0}^{2n} M^j is a 'Poincaré–Hodge' graded object, for example the cohomology of a smooth projective n-fold, with Lefschetz operator L of degree 2. Σ ⊂ End(M) is a graded subalgebra, for example the algebra of algebraic correspondences. It contains:
- L;
- the Künneth projectors π_j;
- the operators w_k : M^{2n-k} → M^k, which invert the hard-Lefschetz isomorphism L^{n-k} : M^k → M^{2n-k} and are zero on the other degrees.

The Lefschetz decomposition is M^i = ⊕_α L^α P^{i-2α} for i ≤ n, where P^k = ker(L^{n-k+1}) ∩ M^k. The projector of M^i onto the α-summand is π_{i,α}; the projector of M^{2n-i} onto L^{n-i+α}P^{i-2α} is π_{2n-i,α}. Λ is the Lefschetz-type 'inverse' of L, with Λ(L^α x) = L^{α-1}x for x primitive and Λ = 0 on primitives. This is the Kleiman-style normalisation, not the sl2 one.

Goal. Show (iii) Λ ∈ Σ and (iv) π_{i,α} ∈ Σ. The method is double induction: ascending on i ≤ n, descending on α.

Step 1 (π_{i,α}). Set q_{i,α} = 1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'}, which lies in Σ by the induction hypothesis (6.8). On M^i, the map L^{n-i+α} q_{i,α} : M^i → M^{2n-i+2α} behaves as follows.
- It kills L^{α'}P^{i-2α'} for α' > α, because q kills those summands.
- It kills them for α' < α, because the total exponent n−i+α+α' ≥ n−(i−2α')+1 annihilates P^{i-2α'}.
- On L^αP^{i-2α}, composed with L^α, it is the injective map L^{n-i+2α} : P^{i-2α} → M^{2n-(i-2α)}.
Applying w_{i-2α} recovers P^{i-2α}, and L^α maps it back. Hence
(6.9) π_{i,α} = L^α w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α} q_{i,α} ∈ Σ.

Step 2 (the dual degree). For i < n,
(6.10) π_{2n-i,α} = L^{n-i} π_{i,α} w_i,
because M^{2n-i} = L^{n-i}M^i, compatibly with the decomposition.

Step 3 (Λ). Write (6.11) Λ = Σ_{j,α} Λ π_{j,α}. It then suffices that each Λπ_{j,α} ∈ Σ. The next page supplies the explicit formulas:
- Λπ_{i,α} = L^{α-1} w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α} π_{i,α} for α ≥ 1;
- Λπ_{2n-i,α} = L^{n-i+α-1} w_{i-2α} L^α π_{2n-i,α}.

Purpose. This is the algebraic core of the statement that the Lefschetz standard conjecture (algebraicity of the inverses w_k of hard Lefschetz) makes Λ and all Lefschetz/primitive-decomposition projectors algebraic. Grothendieck is extracting it into an abstract 'Poincaré–Hodge algebra' formalism. The next page goes on to characterise Λ and the π_{i,α} by identities (6.14) inside the graded ring Σ, writing w_k = Λ^{n-k}.
errors: On the previous page, q_{i,α} = 1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'} is equated with Σ_{α'≤α} π_{i,α'}. This holds only on M^i; globally the second expression is π_i − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'}. Formula (6.9) is still correct, provided w_{i-2α} is taken to be zero outside degree 2n−i+2α, so that the extra components of q are killed.
The numbering (6.9) is reused: an earlier, crossed-out (6.9) on the previous page was Σ_α π_{i,α} = π_i.
Base of the descending induction: one needs π_{i,α} = 0 for α > i/2. This is implicit and trivial.
The formulas are correct only with the Kleiman-type normalisation of Λ (Λ L^α x = L^{α-1}x on primitives), not the sl2 normalisation. This is consistent with the next page's w_k = Λ^{n-k}.

ideas.what: If an algebra of correspondences contains L, the Künneth projectors and the inverses of the hard-Lefschetz isomorphisms, then it contains the Lefschetz-decomposition projectors π_{i,α}. These are given by the explicit recursive formula π_{i,α} = L^α w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α}(1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'}).
ideas.modern_name: Algebraicity of the Lefschetz/primitive decomposition projectors under the Lefschetz standard conjecture B(X)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Standard conjectures, 1968/69); Kleiman, 'Algebraic cycles and the Weil conjectures' (1968)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (Bombay 1968, publ. 1969), where only the statements are given. Detailed proofs are in Kleiman 1968.

ideas.what: Λ expressed inside Σ via Λ = Σ Λπ_{j,α}, with each piece a word in L, w_k and π_{j,α}.
ideas.modern_name: Λ is algebraic iff the w_k are algebraic (equivalent forms of conjecture B)

ideas.what: Duality formula π_{2n-i,α} = L^{n-i} π_{i,α} w_i, transporting projectors from degree i to degree 2n−i.
ideas.modern_name: Hard-Lefschetz transport of the Lefschetz decomposition

missed.claim: This page is a fully worked, explicit-formula version of 'B(X) ⇒ Λ and the Lefschetz projectors are algebraic', placed inside an abstract 'Poincaré–Hodge algebra' (a graded subalgebra Σ ⊂ End M). It leads, on the next page, to an intrinsic characterisation of Λ and the π_{i,α} within Σ. The mathematics is known, via Kleiman 1968. The abstract algebraic packaging and the explicit recursive formulas are an unpublished draft detail rather than a new result.
missed.quote: π_{i,α} = L^α w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α}(1-Σ_{α'>α} π_{iα'}) ce qui donne bien π_{iα} ∈ Σ
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Of historical interest: it documents how Grothendieck derived the standard-conjecture equivalences in an axiomatic correspondence formalism, which is close to the later Lefschetz-module / Kimura–André–Kahn style approaches. It is not new mathematics.

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries out a routine and correct verification that the Lefschetz projectors and Λ lie in the algebra generated by L, the Künneth projectors and the hard-Lefschetz inverses. These are standard consequences of conjecture B, documented in Kleiman 1968 and Grothendieck 1969. Only the explicit recursive formulas and the axiomatic setting are unpublished details.
transcription_corrections: 'w_{i-2α}' is a lowercase w (the inverse of L^{n-k}); the next page writes it as W and then replaces it by Λ^{n-i+2α}.
'le déduit par ex. de la formule' should read roughly '[on] le déduit par ex. de la formule'. The inserted phrase reads 'Cela prouve (6.8') dans (iv)'.
In (6.11) the sum is over (j,α); the crossed-out material after it is illegible.
Final line: 'il suffit de prouver que Λπ_{iα} [and Λπ_{2n-i,α}, crossed] ∈ Σ'.
